  lookahead; 91 run, 15 skipped).

  (2026-10-20 15:32); `corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exit 0; `corepack pnpm build` exit 0. Isolation: every

  Its `node_modules` were deleted after the sweep (`find … -name node_modules | wc -l` → 0).

  file restored from the tree and `filecmp` byte-checked. The whole sweep was run twice (cwd `packages/kernel`, then the
  root config with its fast-check setup): the same 51 verdicts both times.
* Worker count from `tools/test_budget.py` (it printed 1). Timings are informative only and are no result.
* **Disclosure (planning, J183).** This resumed seat read `checks/M0-a-16-notes.md` whole at its start — the source
  notes the brief requires, and with them the author's 'Hardening round S3' section — and `docs/lane-events.log` by
